sections.theory:
Matters of knowledge and action

In family life, in the context of mutual likes and dislikes, if some slip or shortcoming occurs from women, they too should repent in the presence of Allah Almighty and, acknowledging their shortcoming, should also bring improvement in their attitude, so that domestic life remains pleasant and no serious stage arises.

Just as the lofty qualities of the Pure Wives (may Allah be pleased with them) are proof of their high conduct and character, they are also a guiding light for the women of the Ummah. They too should try to create these qualities and this character within themselves.

Allah Almighty has instructed the head of the household that he is responsible not only for the upkeep of his family, but it is also his responsibility to try to save his family and dependants along with himself from the punishment of the Hereafter. In this matter he should arrange for their religious and moral guidance and upbringing in a correct manner.
